name: Haley Stevens
summary: Haley Maria Stevens (born June 24, 1983) is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative from Michigan's 11th congressional district since 2019. Elected as a member of the Democratic Party, Stevens represents most of urbanized Oakland County, including many of Detroit's northern suburbs. A centrist Democrat, Stevens supports campaign finance reform, Israel, manufacturing investment, and strategic tariffs, and opposes the Iran war and abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
